actualWebReading.ownParaphrase: Private decisions can leave costs or benefits with other people. An emissions charge and a targeted subsidy change private incentives in different directions; effectiveness alone does not prove a policy rate equals measured marginal harm.

A fixed emissions price leaves responses and resulting quantities uncertain; a cap fixes covered allowed quantities while the market price may vary. Institutional monitoring and coordination remain important.
